description: This file defines the Recipient class within the OrangeHRM Leave Mail namespace, representing an email recipient with properties for email address, name, and first name. It extends an abstract recipient class and provides getter methods for its properties.

classes.name: Recipient
classes.description: Represents an email recipient with properties for email address, name, and first name, extending the AbstractRecipient class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Recipient with specified email address, name, and first name.

methods.name: getEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the email address of the recipient.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the recipient.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the recipient.
